answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, unlocked only after continuous uptime. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. A haven of per-task receipts records who did what, and the walnut of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The ripple of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
